messages:
Aisha (docs): Quick audit of Optimize toolkit pages  found link rot and inconsistent SDK snippets. Opening small PR to sync examples and add a quant alias mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1510
Priya (devex): Noted. Node examples use old stream API; we should show async iterator. I'll add a compact TS snippet.
Kai (eng-ml): Also saw telemetry showing 'q4f' while docs use 'q4_0'. Please add a YAML mapping and a tiny migration note. Avoid wording that implies quant improves accuracy.
Sam (engineer): Pasting a short Python snippet and YAML alias mapping to drop into the PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
res = client.generate('Summarize: key bullets', model='redwood-2b', max_tokens=100, batch_policy='adaptive', cache_prefix_enabled=True)
print(res.text)
```
```yaml
quant_profile_aliases:
  q4_0: [q4f, q4-fast]
```
Aisha (docs): Perfect. I'll update the PR with these snippets plus a one-line FAQ: "If runtime logs show q4f, use q4_0 in docs." Merging after quick sign-offs.
